description: Adds a review specialist, a reusable workflow, and review guidance.

release-reviewer.description: Reviews release safety and rollback evidence.
release-reviewer.prompt: Review the requested change. Use read, glob, grep, and lsp for repository evidence; use webfetch or web_search when current external evidence is required; use bash only for bounded environment or verification commands. Focus on authorization, durable state, rollback, and concrete verification. Do not delegate. Return findings before summaries.

release-review.description: Review a release candidate with the packaged specialist.
release-review.prompt: Call the task tool once with subagent_type="release-reviewer", background=false, and this prompt: Review this release candidate using repository files, relevant environment facts, and current network evidence when needed: $ARGUMENTS. Return the delegated findings to the user.

skills.name: release-safety
skills.description: Use when reviewing a release, deployment, rollback plan, or production gate.
skills.content: Check immutable inputs, authorization boundaries, rollback evidence, observability, and the exact commands that completed successfully.
